> 吾言甚易知，甚易行。天下莫能知，莫能行.

Chapter 69 was about standing at the door of the dead. Chapter 70 is Laozi speaking in his own voice about why nobody has picked it up.

Two characters carry it, and both are objects.

## 則 is a line carved on a ding

The bronze form of 則 is 鼎 (the ritual vessel) plus 刀 (a knife).

說文 gives 則 as four characters: 則，等畫物也 — 等 is to make equal, 畫 is to draw the line.

So 則 is the notch cut into the vessel, used to bring other things level against it.

> 知我者希，則我者貴.

則我 is not "approve of me," not "follow me," not "imitate me." It is: take me as that line.

Which is the same act as the 易's 天垂象，聖人則之 — heaven lets down a form, and the sage cuts it into the vessel. One descends, one incises: two halves of a single movement.

## 被褐而懷玉

褐: 編枲襪也，一曰粗衣 — a coarse garment woven of hemp, the clothing of the poor.

玉 is not an ornament here. 玉 hung on the outside is decoration; 玉 held against the chest is a token of trust.

The image is therefore exact: outside, the clothing of the lowest; inside, the pledge of the highest.

被褐 is "the same as them." 懷玉 is "the one thing that is not."

## 言有宗，事有君

Words have an ancestor; affairs have a master.

宗 is the ancestral shrine — the thing a line comes from. 君 is the one in charge of a thing.

So the chapter's claim about its own words is not that they are simple. It is that they are descended: everything said traces back to one source, and everything done answers to one authority.

## 夫唯無知，是以不我知

Precisely because they do not know, they do not know me.

無知 here is not stupidity. It is the absence of the thing that would let the words land — chapter 65's 智: the angled intelligence that turns every statement into a position.

## 易知易行

易 is not "simple." The chapter's own framing makes it 直 — direct, without detour.

What is direct is hard to argue with and easy to be unimpressed by. Difficulty is what makes a thing look valuable.

## Why this follows 69

69: what decides a matched contest is whether one side still remembers the cost.
70: and that is why so few take it up — the position has no visible advantage.

The chapter is not complaining. It is diagnosing a mismatch between the register in which the thing is true and the register in which people evaluate.

## A test

Take the last good advice you received and did not follow. Ask whether the reason was that it was wrong, or that it was too plainly right to feel like an insight.
